test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 25 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the idiom in bold in the given sentence.

I am going to **take a leaf out of your book** and start packing my own lunches.

options.text: A book containing a list of secret contacts
Imitate or emulate someone in a particular way
Be in somebody's favour or good opinion

solution: The correct answer is** 'Option 3' i.e. 'Imitate or emulate someone in a particular way'** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"Take a leaf out of your book"** means to copy something that someone else does because it will bring one advantages. • **Example:** I decided to take a leaf out of your book and start early morning jogging. • The phrase** "Imitate or emulate someone in a particular way"** accurately captures the meaning of this idiom.(किसी विशेष तरीके से किसी की अनुकरण करना) • **Example:** She always tries to imitate her teacher's way of speaking. **Therefore, the correct answer is - 'Option 3'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Option 1,** "To study very hard"** means to apply oneself with a great deal of diligence and effort in learning or understanding a subject.(काफी कठिनाई से पढ़ाई करना) • Option 2, **"A book containing a list of secret contacts" **refers to a resource containing a hidden or unpublicized network of associates or acquaintances. (एक पुस्तक जिसमें गुप्त संपर्कों की सूची होती है). • Option 4**, "Be in somebody's favour or good opinion"** means to be approved or endorsed by someone.(किसी के पक्ष में होना या अच्छी राय रखना) 18f:Tc3a, The correct answer is: **Circamference**
